annotator: hand-annotated by reading all cues; method in docs/ad-analyzer.md
method: Every cue was read. A segment starts at the first cue whose spoken words belong to the promo and ends at the last such cue. Cues marked ambiguous are judgement calls and are excluded from strict scoring.
